title: register_agent input
description: §4.6 AFFORDANCE, and NOT one of §6.1's six (D-159). It submits this agent's own registration on the HOL anchor §9.5 names, with the AGENT as payer and signer — which is the one submission in WISHMail the agent pays for, and the reason its account holds ℏ at all (§3.9: funding is a payment and not a party). It matters who paid: §9.5 assigns `blurred` where the registration's payer is not the address's account, and every agent currently on the testnet anchor carries it. It takes no arguments: the address, the uaid and the registry are the agent's own, read from the declaration it already published. Idempotent against consensus — the anchor is read in full first, and a registration this account already has is left alone, because §9.5 assigns `vague` where more than one names an address and a duplicate cannot be withdrawn (D-165).

dryRun.description: Read the anchor, report whether a registration exists and what would be submitted, and submit nothing.
